item.title: Ukraine Begs Citizens to Stock Up on Food as Corruption Turns It Into Black Hole For Western Aid
item.summary: Banker-turned Ukrainian Armed Forces officer Andrii Onistrat’s call for Ukrainians to stockpile two months-worth of food and other essentials ahead of a possible total loss of electricity and heating capacity is meant as a “signal” to Kiev’s sponsors to pony up more cash, says political analyst Alexander Asafov.
